jobs.title: Content Creator Specialist
jobs.description: Key Responsibilities: - Menyusun strategi konten end-to-end dan mengelola content calendar bulanan untuk TikTok, Instagram Reels, dan platform media sosial lainnya. - Menjadi talent utama di depan kamera yang dapat merepresentasikan target audience Momelca secara autentik, menarik, dan percaya diri. - Mampu mengemas video yang menunjukkan Unique Selling Proposition (USP) atau keunggulan produk Momelca (seperti cuttingan yang pas, anti-kusut, dll.) menjadi video visual yang jelas, edukatif, namun tetap estetis dan menjual. - Menulis naskah (scripting), mengarahkan visual, dan memproduksi video hiburan bernuansa soft selling yang halus namun efektif mendorong penjualan. - Aktif memantau tren fashion, audio viral, serta budaya terkini untuk diadaptasi menjadi ide konten yang fresh. - Membuat copywriting/caption, teks video, dan Call to Action (CTA) yang kuat untuk memicu interaksi engagement audiens. - Berkoordinasi dengan tim Marketing, Desain, dan Gudang terkait peluncuran produk baru, highlighting feature, dan ketersediaan stok. - Menganalisis metrik performa video (reach, engagement, conversion) dan reporting sebagai evaluasi berkala kepada BOD untuk perbaikan strategi. Requirements: - Minimal 2 tahun pengalaman sebagai Content Creator, Video Creator, atau Copywriter (diutamakan berpengalaman di industri fashion, lifestyle, atau e-commerce). - Background studi S1 di Pemasaran, Komunikasi, DKV, Produksi Media, atau bidang terkait (pengalaman praktis dan portofolio kuat lebih diutamakan). - Percaya diri, memiliki ekspresi yang natural, dan berpengalaman menjadi on-camera talent. - Mahir menggunakan aplikasi editing video di smartphone maupun laptop (CapCut, Premiere Pro, InShot, dll.). - Menguasai alat desain dasar (Canva/Photoshop) untuk kebutuhan materi promosi ringan. - Memahami dasar-dasar pengambilan gambar (lighting, sudut kamera, dan mikrofon). - Memiliki portofolio yang menampilkan karya video pendek (TikTok/Reels), naskah konten, serta pencapaian performa video yang pernah dibuat (WAJIB) . - Memiliki storytelling yang kuat, pemahaman selera humor yang relevan dengan anak kantor, adaptif, terbiasa dengan deadline, dan proaktif.

jobs.title: Affiliate Marketing Supervisor
jobs.description: AFFILIATE MARKETING SUPERVISOR Responsibilities Develop and manage affiliate marketing strategies to drive sales and growth. Find and categorize influential individuals across various industries and communities. Foster relationships and maintain strong communication with existing affiliates. Collaborate with key internal stakeholders to ensure alignment with marketing objectives. Negotiate partnership agreements, compensation terms, and campaign deliverables with affiliates. Monitor traffic sources and campaign performance to evaluate affiliate program effectiveness. Report on KPIs and analyze performance data to optimize affiliate marketing strategies. Lead, motivate, and develop the Affiliate team. Requirements Minimum 3 years of proven experience in Affiliate Marketing or a related role. Extensive network and database of affiliates. Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, or a related field. Proven experience managing a diverse range of affiliates or talents, preferably in the beauty industry. Willing to work full-time onsite (WFO) at Summarecon Bekasi.

jobs.title: Staff Accounting & Pajak (Marketplace)
jobs.description: Posisi Staff Accounting & Pajak (Marketplace) bertanggung jawab dalam mengelola pencatatan transaksi keuangan, rekonsiliasi penjualan marketplace, administrasi perpajakan, serta memastikan seluruh proses berjalan sesuai dengan standar akuntansi dan peraturan perpajakan yang berlaku. Tanggung Jawab : Melakukan pencatatan transaksi keuangan harian secara akurat. Melakukan rekonsiliasi penjualan dan pembayaran dari marketplace (Shopee, Tokopedia, TikTok Shop, Lazada, dan platform lainnya). Membantu penyusunan jurnal, laporan keuangan bulanan, dan proses closing. Menghitung, menyetor, dan membantu pelaporan pajak perusahaan (PPN, PPh 21, PPh 23, dan pajak lainnya). Mengelola administrasi perpajakan, termasuk e-Faktur, e-Bupot, Coretax, dan DJP Online. Membuat, memeriksa, dan mengelola dokumen Bukti Potong (Bupot) sesuai ketentuan perpajakan. Memastikan seluruh transaksi terdokumentasi dengan baik sesuai standar akuntansi dan peraturan perpajakan. Berkoordinasi dengan tim Finance, Sales, Operasional, dan Marketplace terkait transaksi penjualan. Menyiapkan data dan dokumen untuk kebutuhan audit internal maupun eksternal. Kualifikasi : usia maksimal 35 tahun. Pendidikan minimal S1 Akuntansi atau Perpajakan . Fresh Graduate dipersilakan melamar. Memahami dasar-dasar akuntansi dan perpajakan Indonesia. Memahami proses pembuatan dan administrasi Bukti Potong Pajak (Bupot) . Memiliki Sertifikat Brevet Pajak A & B menjadi nilai tambah. Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Table, IF, SUMIFS menjadi nilai tambah). Terbiasa menggunakan software akuntansi seperti Accurate, Jurnal, atau sejenisnya menjadi nilai tambah. Memahami Coretax, e-Faktur, dan DJP Online menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki pengalaman magang di bidang Accounting, Finance, atau Tax menjadi nilai tambah. Teliti, jujur, bertanggung jawab, memiliki kemampuan analitis, serta kemauan belajar yang tinggi. Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim. Waktu Kerja : Senin - Sabtu Pukul : 08.00 - 16.00 WIB kirimkan CV dan Dokumen Pendukung ke ••••@gmail.com

Assist lecturers during instructional sessions, including supporting students in using relevant software and tools for event management preparation. Facilitate connections between students and industry professionals for case studies, mentorship, and event collaborations. Manage and maintain green screen operations for virtual and multimedia productions. Serve as Front of House (FOH) personnel for Nusantara Hall.

jobs.title: Customer Service
jobs.description: About the Role: We are looking for a dedicated and proactive Customer Service professional to join our team. As the main point of contact for customers across various platforms, you will handle inquiries, resolve complaints, and process orders to ensure a smooth and positive customer experience. You will work closely with internal teams to address order and shipping issues, playing a key role in maintaining customer satisfaction and loyalty. By delivering timely, accurate information about our products and services, you will represent the face of our company and contribute to its success. Responsibilities: Respond to customer inquiries promptly and professionally. Handle product issues, returns, and exchanges. Manage and track orders, ensuring timely delivery. Collaborate with the logistics team to resolve shipping issues. Maintain accurate records of customer interactions. Monitor and respond to customer reviews and feedback. Provide product and policy information. Continuously improve service procedures based on feedback.

jobs.title: HubSpot Developer and API & AI Automation Contractor
jobs.description: KPS is seeking an experienced, remote HubSpot Developer / API & AI Automation Contractor to work directly with our U.S.-based team on the development, customization, integration, and automation of our business systems. Pay- $2,000/month This is a hands-on technical role beyond standard HubSpot administration. Looking for a developer who can customize HubSpot CRM and CMS, build API integrations between software platforms, develop advanced workflows and automations, support marketing campaigns, and build AI-powered tools and bots that can extract, organize, analyze, and act on business data. The ideal candidate is someone who can understand a business process, identify how technology can improve it, and then design and build the solution . HubSpot CRM Development & Customization Customize HubSpot CRM for our sales, estimating, customer service, operations, and marketing teams. Create and manage: Custom properties/objects Deal pipelines/stages Contact and company records Associations between records Lead routing, Task automation, Sales/approval sequences Build automated actions based on deal stage changes, customer activity, dates, values, or other business conditions. Create workflows that automatically update records, assign tasks, notify employees, generate follow-up actions, and move information between departments. Improve CRM data structure, consistency, and usability. Assist with HubSpot reporting, dashboards, attribution, and management reporting. HubSpot CMS & Website Development Customize/maintain existing previously built HubSpot CMS websites and landing pages. Build/modify: Website templates Landing pages Forms Modules Dynamic content Calls-to-action Customer-facing forms and portals Connect website activity and form submissions directly into CRM processes and automated workflows. Support SEO, tracking, conversion optimization, and website analytics. API Development & Software Integrations Working with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, OAuth, and API authentication. Connecting HubSpot with ERP, accounting, estimating, project management, customer service, communication, marketing, and other software platforms. Building custom middleware or integration applications when native integrations are not available. Creating two-way data synchronization between systems. Mapping data fields between different applications. Automating the transfer of contacts, companies, deals, projects, pricing, products, documents, and other business information. Troubleshooting API errors, failed synchronization, authentication issues, and data conflicts. Creating documentation for integrations and workflows. AI Bots, Data Extraction & Business Automation Extract information from documents, PDFs, emails, websites, CRM records, and other data sources. Compare information between systems. Populate CRM fields automatically. Create tasks or workflows based on extracted information. Analyze customer or project information. Generate responses, summaries, reports, or recommendations. Trigger HubSpot workflows or API actions based on AI analysis. Experience working with OpenAI APIs, AI agents, large language models, vector databases, OCR/document processing, or similar AI technologies is highly desirable. Assist with Marketing automation, Deal and sales automation, Cross-Platform Automation, project collaboration, and more. Other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Technical Lead
jobs.description: Pengembangan Kode: Menulis kode aplikasi yang efisien, rapi, dan mudah dikelola sesuai dengan standar perusahaan (keamanan dan performa). Jaminan Kualitas: Memastikan setiap fungsi berjalan lancar tanpa bug dan memenuhi kriteria yang ditentukan. Code Review & Mentoring: Memeriksa kode rekan tim, serta membimbing anggota tim yang lebih junior terkait best practice dan standar penulisan kode. Kolaborasi Tim: Bekerja sama dengan System Analyst, tim QC, BA, dan UI/UX untuk memastikan proyek selesai tepat waktu. Inovasi: Mengimplementasikan perangkat berbasis AI untuk mempercepat proses pengembangan (SDLC). Pemeliharaan: Melakukan pembaruan (patching), memperbaiki bug, dan mendokumentasikan panduan penggunaan aplikasi. Dukungan Teknis: Jika diperlukan, membantu tim bisnis dalam proses Proof of Concept (POC) atau uji coba aplikasi.

jobs.title: ISP Operations Internship
jobs.description: ISP Operations Internship Bertugas memberikan dukungan administratif, dokumentasi, dan pengembangan materi operasional kepada tim Strategic Partner Commercial. Posisi ini berperan dalam membantu penyusunan standar kerja, dokumentasi proses bisnis, serta kebutuhan koordinasi operasional sehingga aktivitas divisi dapat berjalan lebih efektif dan terdokumentasi dengan baik. Job Description Membantu menyusun, memperbarui, dan mengelola panduan kerja (SOP/Work Instruction/Guidebook) sesuai kebutuhan operasional divisi. Membantu menyusun materi presentasi, pelatihan, maupun kebutuhan komunikasi internal. Mendukung penyusunan dokumentasi operasional, termasuk pengarsipan digital dan standardisasi dokumen. Memberikan dukungan teknis dasar terkait penggunaan dokumen, template, maupun tools operasional yang digunakan oleh tim. Memberikan dukungan administratif kepada tim Strategic Partner Commercial sesuai kebutuhan operasional yang relevan. Mendukung persiapan dan pelaksanaan kegiatan operasional divisi, seperti pelatihan, sosialisasi, meeting, maupun kegiatan koordinasi lainnya. Kualifikasi Mahasiswa semester akhir atau Fresh Graduate D3/S1 semua jurusan (diutamakan Teknik/Telekomunikasi/Sistem Informasi/Jurusan yang relevan). Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik. Memiliki rasa ingin tahu yang tinggi, proaktif, serta memiliki kemauan belajar terhadap proses bisnis dan operasional perusahaan. Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Office dan Google Workspace. Memiliki kemampuan menyusun dokumen, presentasi, atau laporan secara rapi dan sistematis. Memiliki pengetahuan atau pengalaman di industri Telekomunikasi, Internet Service Provider (ISP), atau teknologi informasi menjadi nilai tambah.

jobs.title: PPIC & Supply Chain Staff (FnB)
jobs.description: Job descriptions : Production & Demand Planning : Membuat production planning berdasarkan forecast penjualan, historical sales, dan kebutuhan outlet. Inventory Control : Menentukan minimum stock, maximum stock, dan reorder point. Material Requirement Planning : Membuat Material Requirement Planning (MRP) berdasarkan forecast dan production plan. Coordination with Purchasing Food Cost & Waste Control : Mengidentifikasi potensi variance antara theoretical usage dan actual usage. Reporting & Analysis : Inventory Report; Stock Movement Report; Stock Aging Report; Material Requirement Report; Production Planning Report, etc Coordination with Outlet & Operations : Berkoordinasi dengan Outlet Manager/Operations mengenai forecast dan kebutuhan bahan. Qualifications: Minimum D3/S1 in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Management, Logistics, Accounting, or related field. 1–2 years of experience in PPIC, Inventory Control, Warehouse, Purchasing, or Supply Chain; F&B experience is preferred. Strong understanding of inventory management, forecasting, material planning, FIFO/FEFO, and stock control. Familiar with BOM/recipe, food cost, material variance, yield, and waste monitoring. Proficient in Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets and data analysis. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills. Detail-oriented, organized, proactive, and able to work in a fast-paced F&B environment. Experience handling central kitchen and/or multi-outlet operations is an advantage.
jobs.raw:
{"@context": "https://schema.org/", "@type": "JobPosting", "title": "PPIC & Supply Chain Staff (FnB)", "description": "

Job descriptions :

  1. Production & Demand Planning : Membuat production planning berdasarkan forecast penjualan, historical sales, dan kebutuhan outlet.

  2. Inventory Control : Menentukan minimum stock, maximum stock, dan reorder point.

  3. Material Requirement Planning : Membuat Material Requirement Planning (MRP) berdasarkan forecast dan production plan.

  4. Coordination with Purchasing

  5. Food Cost & Waste Control : Mengidentifikasi potensi variance antara theoretical usage dan actual usage.

  6. Reporting & Analysis : Inventory Report; Stock Movement Report; Stock Aging Report; Material Requirement Report; Production Planning Report, etc

  7. Coordination with Outlet & Operations : Berkoordinasi dengan Outlet Manager/Operations mengenai forecast dan kebutuhan bahan.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum D3/S1 in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Management, Logistics, Accounting, or related field.

  • 1–2 years of experience in PPIC, Inventory Control, Warehouse, Purchasing, or Supply Chain; F&B experience is preferred.

  • Strong understanding of inventory management, forecasting, material planning, FIFO/FEFO, and stock control.

  • Familiar with BOM/recipe, food cost, material variance, yield, and waste monitoring.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets and data analysis.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills.

  • Detail-oriented, organized, proactive, and able to work in a fast-paced F&B environment.

  • Experience handling central kitchen and/or multi-outlet operations is an advantage.

{"@context": "https://schema.org/", "@type": "JobPosting", "title": "Admin HR", "description": "

Deskripsi Pekerjaan:

  • Mengelola dan menjadwalkan pelatihan karyawan (induksi, OJT, lanjutan)

  • Menyiapkan kebutuhan pelatihan (materi, absensi, evaluasi)

  • Menginput dan mengelola data training dalam sistem/database

  • Membantu proses rekrutmen (posting lowongan, screening CV, penjadwalan interview)

  • Mengkoordinasikan jadwal interview dengan kandidat dan user

  • Mengelola database kandidat dan arsip dokumen rekrutmen

  • Mendukung proses onboarding karyawan baru (dokumen, kontrak, dll)

  • Berkoordinasi dengan tim HR, trainer, dan user terkait training & rekrutmen

  • Menjadi penghubung antara kandidat/karyawan dengan tim HR

  • Membuat laporan berkala aktivitas training dan rekrutmen

  • Menjaga kerapihan dan kelengkapan dokumen HR (softcopy & hardcopy)

Kualifikasi:

  • Pendidikan minimal S1 (Psikologi, Manajemen SDM, Administrasi, atau jurusan terkait)

  • Pengalaman minimal 2 tahun di bidang HR, khususnya training atau rekrutmen

  • Memahami alur proses rekrutmen dan pelatihan karyawan

  • Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Office (terutama Excel dan Word)

  • Memiliki kemampuan administrasi dan pengolahan data yang baik

  • Memiliki komunikasi yang baik dan mampu bekerja secara tim

jobs.title: Direct Sales Agent (Malang)
jobs.description: PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk adalah perusahaan yang berkomitmen untuk menghubungkan setiap warga Indonesia agar hidupnya lebih baik. Sebagai salah satu pemain terkuat di industri telekomunikasi Indonesia, kami melebihi koneksi—kami membangun jembatan yang bermakna yang memperkuat kehidupan, memperkuat komunitas, dan mendorong bangsa untuk maju bersama. XLSMART dikenal sebagai pemimpin industri dalam kredibilitas, kepercayaan, dan inovasi, serta terus menetapkan standar dalam memberikan solusi digital yang andal dan mutakhir sesuai dengan kebutuhan stakeholder. Yang membedakan kami sebagai pemimpin inovasi adalah pendekatan berbasis manusia. Di inti kesuksesan luar biasa kami adalah budaya praktis dan visioner yang disebut prinsip nilai i-CARE: Integritas, Pelanggan di Hati, Bertindak Seperti Pemilik, Bangkit Bersama, Menikmati Setiap Langkah. Nilai-nilai ini adalah prinsip yang telah membentuk segala sesuatu yang kami lakukan dan telah menjadi kebiasaan sehari-hari. Kami menciptakan lingkungan kerja inovatif, inklusif, dan kolaboratif di mana bakat berkembang, ide berkembang, dan memberikan peluang karier dengan rasa syukur dan kebahagiaan. XLSMART bukan hanya tempat kerja yang hebat—ini adalah tempat terbaik untuk berkembang menjadi versi terbaik dari individu yang luar biasa. Jangan pernah mengatakan tidak untuk berkembang bersama XLSMART, bersama kita akan menjalani perjalanan yang penuh hasil—kamu, aku, dan setiap karyawan, bersatu dalam meredefinisikan masa depan Indonesia. Kualifikasi (Requirements): Wanita atau Pria usia minimal 18 tahun dan maksimal 45 tahun Pendidikan minimal SMA atau sederajat Pengalaman di bidang penjualan langsung Siap bekerja di lapangan Memiliki motor dan SIM C Bersedia bekerja dibawah pihak ketiga Benefit Penghasilan bulanan Insentif penjualan yang menarik Jenjang karir Program pengembangan kompetensi bersertifikasi Tertarik jadi bagian dari perjalanan kami? Apply sekarang, dan menjadi bagian dari XLSMART Warrior!

jobs.title: IT Application Officer
jobs.description: Job Description - Manage and support business applications their lifecycle to ensure system availability, performance, and continuous improvement. - Analyze business requirements and deliver application solutions, enhancements, and system integrations that support business operations. - Provide Level 2 application support by troubleshooting issues, performing root cause analysis, and coordinating with vendors to ensure timely resolution. - Monitor application performance, perform preventive maintenance, and ensure system security, stability, backup, and recovery processes. - Collaborate with business users on requirements gathering, implementation, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), training, and post-implementation support. - Manage user access, maintain application documentation, and ensure compliance with IT policies, standards, and audit requirements. - Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve business processes and user experience. Requirements - Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Accounting Information System, or a related field. - Minimum 5-8 years of experience in Application Support, Business Applications, ERP, or a similar role, including at least two end-to-end ERP or enterprise system implementations. - Strong knowledge of SDLC, SQL, ERP/business applications, and system integration. - Experience in application troubleshooting, UAT, vendor management, and stakeholder collaboration. - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. - ITIL Foundation or other relevant certifications are an advantage.

jobs.title: KURIR MOTOR J&T EXPRESS DC SETIA BUDI
jobs.description: Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab: Melakukan pengantaran paket kepada pelanggan sesuai dengan area yang telah ditentukan. Menjemput paket dari pelanggan atau agen sesuai kebutuhan operasional. Memastikan paket diterima oleh penerima yang benar dan dalam kondisi baik. Melakukan proses scan paket menggunakan aplikasi perusahaan pada setiap tahapan pengiriman. Menjaga keamanan dan kerahasiaan paket selama proses pengiriman. Kualifikasi: Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK sederajat. Memiliki kendaraan bermotor pribadi dan SIM C yang masih berlaku. Memahami area pengiriman dan mampu menggunakan aplikasi navigasi seperti GPS. Memiliki smartphone Android yang mendukung aplikasi operasional. Sehat jasmani dan rohani. Jujur, disiplin, bertanggung jawab, dan memiliki etos kerja yang baik. Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim. Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem target dan mengikuti jam operasional perusahaan. Keahlian yang Dibutuhkan: Kemampuan mengatur waktu dengan baik. Komunikasi yang baik dengan pelanggan. Teliti dalam menangani paket dan administrasi pengiriman. Mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan

jobs.title: IT Network/Network Engineer
jobs.description: Company CBRE Job Description Merancang ( design ), memelihara ( maintain ), dan memecahkan masalah ( troubleshoot ) infrastruktur jaringan. Memastikan konektivitas jaringan tetap stabil, aman, dan berkinerja tinggi ( stable and secure connectivity ). Melakukan pemantauan rutin, pembaruan keamanan, dan optimasi pada perangkat jaringan (router, switch, firewall, dll). Job Requirements S1 (Sarjana) jurusan Teknik Informatika, Teknik Komputer, Telekomunikasi, atau jurusan terkait. Sertifikasi ITIL 4 Foundation (wajib); minimal salah satu dari: Cisco CCNP; Cisco CCNA dengan sertifikasi tingkat lanjut ( advanced ) yang relevan; atau sertifikasi jaringan tingkat lanjut setara yang diakui di industri. Pengalaman minimal 3-5 tahun di bidang terkait. Memiliki pemahaman mendalam tentang konsep jaringan ( routing, switching, network security, VPN, network monitoring ). Kemampuan analitis yang kuat dalam mengidentifikasi serta menyelesaikan kendala jaringan ( troubleshooting ).

jobs.title: Manager Kredit Produktif
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari Manager Kredit Produktif yang berpengalaman dan berdedikasi untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di PT. Bank Perekonomian Rakyat Modern Express. Sebagai Manager Kredit Produktif, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam mengelola portofolio kredit yang berkembang dan memastikan pertumbuhan bisnis yang berkelanjutan di seluruh Wilayah Kerja BPR Modex. Posisi ini memerlukan profesional yang memiliki pemahaman mendalam tentang analisis kredit, manajemen risiko, dan kemampuan membangun hubungan bisnis yang kuat. Jabatan ini merupakan posisi fulltime yang memungkinkan Anda untuk berkontribusi secara signifikan terhadap kesuksesan operasional bank.. Tanggung Jawab Mengelola dan mengembangkan portofolio kredit produktif dengan fokus pada pertumbuhan dan profitabilitas yang berkelanjutan Melakukan analisis kredit komprehensif terhadap calon peminjam, termasuk evaluasi kelayakan, kapasitas pembayaran, dan jaminan Memproses, mengevaluasi, dan merekomendasikan permohonan kredit sesuai dengan kebijakan bank dan standar regulasi yang berlaku Membangun dan memelihara hubungan strategis dengan klien korporat, UMKM, dan segmen bisnis lainnya. Memantau dan mengelola kualitas kredit serta melakukan upaya penyelamatan kredit bermasalah Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap regulasi Bank Indonesia, OJK, dan standar internal bank dalam setiap keputusan kredit Menyiapkan laporan periodik mengenai kinerja portofolio kredit, analisis tren pasar, dan rekomendasi strategis Melatih dan membimbing tim kredit untuk memastikan standar layanan dan proses yang konsisten Mengidentifikasi peluang bisnis baru dan strategi untuk meningkatkan market share di segmen kredit produktif Persyaratan Pendidikan minimal Strata 1 (S1) dalam bidang Manajemen, Akuntansi, Ekonomi, Hukum, atau bidang terkait Minimal 7-10 tahun pengalaman di bidang perbankan, khususnya dalam manajemen kredit atau kredit produktif Pengalaman dalam analisis kredit, strukturisasi kredit, dan pemahaman mendalam tentang manajemen risiko kredit Pengetahuan yang kuat mengenai regulasi perbankan Indonesia, termasuk kebijakan Bank Indonesia dan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan Kemampuan analitis yang sangat baik untuk mengevaluasi kelayakan finansial dan risiko bisnis Keterampilan komunikasi dan negosiasi yang excellent untuk membangun hubungan klien yang efektif Kemampuan memimpin dan mengembangkan tim yang solid Pemahaman tentang teknologi perbankan digital dan sistem informasi manajemen kredit Bersedia bekerja di lokasi Ambon, Maluku dengan dedikasi penuh Tentang Kami PT. Bank Perekonomian Rakyat Modern Express adalah lembaga keuangan terpercaya yang berkomitmen untuk mendukung pertumbuhan ekonomi Indonesia Timur dan pemberdayaan masyarakat melalui layanan perbankan yang inovatif dan terjangkau. Dengan fokus pada kepercayaan, integritas, dan keunggulan layanan, kami telah membangun reputasi solid sebagai mitra keuangan yang dapat diandalkan di wilayah operasional kami. Bank kami beroperasi dengan nilai-nilai fundamental yang mengutamakan kepatuhan regulasi, manajemen risiko yang prudent, dan kepuasan pelanggan. Kami percaya bahwa pertumbuhan berkelanjutan dapat dicapai melalui tim profesional yang berdedikasi, inovasi berkelanjutan, dan komitmen terhadap standar kualitas tertinggi dalam industri perbankan.

jobs.title: Primary Assistant Teacher
jobs.description: Mahatma Gandhi School is seeking a dedicated and enthusiastic Primary Assistant Teacher to support our Primary teaching team in creating a positive, engaging, and student-centered learning environment. Responsibilities Assist the Primary Teacher in planning and delivering engaging classroom activities. Support students during lessons, group activities, and individual learning. Help maintain a safe, organized, and positive classroom environment. Provide additional support to students who require assistance with their learning. Assist with classroom preparation, displays, learning materials, and resources. Monitor students’ behavior, participation, and well-being. Support school activities, events, and other academic programs. Communicate and collaborate effectively with teachers and school staff. Follow school policies and safeguarding procedures. Requirements Minimum Diploma/Bachelor’s Degree in Education, Early Childhood Education, Psychology, or a related field. Previous experience working with Primary-level students is preferred. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Patient, caring, responsible, and enthusiastic when working with children. Able to work collaboratively as part of a teaching team. Good command of English, both written and spoken. Experience in an international or Cambridge curriculum school is an advantage. Fresh graduates with a strong interest in education are welcome to apply.

jobs.title: Marketing Faskes (Surabaya)
jobs.description: Persyaratan Pendidikan minimal Strata 1 (S1) dari berbagai jurusan. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun sebagai Sales Alat Kesehatan atau sebagai Sales Farmasi. Memahami alur pengadaan barang dan jasa di rumah sakit, klinik, laboratorium, maupun fasilitas kesehatan lainnya. Memiliki pengetahuan mengenai proses pengadaan pada sektor manufaktur, industri makanan dan minuman, laboratorium, farmasi, dan industri terkait. Terampil mengoperasikan Microsoft Excel serta Google Sheets untuk pengolahan dan analisis data. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, presentasi, negosiasi yang baik, dan suka bekerja di lapangan Berorientasi pada target, memiliki inisiatif tinggi, disiplin, serta mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. Bersedia ditempatkan dan melakukan aktivitas kerja di wilayah Surabaya. Tanggung Jawab Mengidentifikasi dan mengembangkan peluang bisnis baru melalui perluasan jaringan distributor, reseller, maupun mitra penjualan. Menjalin hubungan profesional yang berkelanjutan dengan pelanggan dan calon pelanggan. Memberikan pendampingan produk, edukasi, serta konsultasi kepada pengguna dan pelanggan. Melakukan pemetaan pasar, pengumpulan informasi kompetitor, dan analisis kebutuhan pelanggan. Menyusun laporan aktivitas penjualan dan perkembangan pasar melalui sistem CRM perusahaan. Berkolaborasi dengan tim internal dalam pengembangan produk dan strategi pemasaran. jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description: Bertanggung jawab penuh atas seluruh siklus proyek, mulai dari tahap perencanaan hingga serah terima proyek. Menyusun Project Execution Plan , jadwal pelaksanaan proyek, serta anggaran proyek, dan memastikan pelaksanaannya berjalan sesuai rencana. Memastikan proyek selesai sesuai target kualitas, waktu, biaya, dan keselamatan kerja. Berkoordinasi dengan pemilik proyek, konsultan desain, konsultan pengawas, kontraktor, subkontraktor, pemasok, serta instansi pemerintah. Mengelola proyek pembangunan kawasan industri, pabrik, gedung perkantoran, data center, utilitas, jalan, dan infrastruktur lainnya. Mengidentifikasi risiko proyek serta menyusun strategi mitigasi untuk memastikan proyek berjalan lancar. Memimpin dan mengawasi tim proyek guna meningkatkan efektivitas pelaksanaan proyek. Memastikan kualitas pekerjaan sesuai dengan spesifikasi teknis, standar nasional, dan peraturan konstruksi yang berlaku di Indonesia. Menyampaikan laporan berkala kepada manajemen mengenai progres proyek, pengendalian biaya, dan potensi risiko. Memimpin rapat koordinasi proyek dan memastikan seluruh keputusan rapat ditindaklanjuti. Membantu proses pengadaan, evaluasi vendor, negosiasi kontrak, dan pengendalian biaya proyek. Membantu pengurusan perizinan proyek apabila diperlukan. Menyelesaikan berbagai permasalahan teknis maupun manajerial yang muncul selama pelaksanaan proyek.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager (BDM)
jobs.description: About the role BridgeCore is seeking a Business Development Manager to help develop the company in the Indonesian market. This is not simply a sales position. You will work directly with the founders and will have the opportunity to participate in building the sales process, client relationships and commercial strategy from the early stage of the company. Your primary responsibility will be to identify potential clients, understand their business needs and develop long-term relationships that can turn into technology projects. You do not need to be a developer. The technical team will be responsible for designing and validating technical solutions. However, you should be curious about technology and willing to learn enough to confidently discuss business and technology needs with clients. Key responsibilities Identify and approach potential B2B clients in Indonesia Build and maintain long-term client relationships Generate and qualify new business opportunities Arrange and conduct initial client meetings Understand clients' business problems and objectives Conduct initial discovery and collect project requirements Identify decision makers, timelines and potential budgets Coordinate opportunities with the technical and project teams in Poland Prepare clear internal handovers after client discussions Participate in proposal preparation and commercial discussions Follow up consistently with prospects and clients Maintain accurate information in CRM Manage activities, meetings and internal tasks through Jira Build and manage a healthy sales pipeline Provide regular feedback about the Indonesian market and client needs Contribute ideas to improve BridgeCore's sales and operating processes About you Proactive and entrepreneurial Responsible and reliable Highly communicative Comfortable building relationships Curious and willing to learn Organised and disciplined Able to work independently Comfortable taking ownership Honest and transparent Confident communicating with senior business stakeholders Comfortable working in an international team Experience Ideally, you have: experience in B2B sales, business development or account management experience working with corporate clients experience selling services or solutions understanding of the Indonesian business environment experience working with CRM systems good communication and negotiation skills Experience in IT, software, technology services or digital solutions would be a strong advantage, but it is not mandatory. An existing professional network among Indonesian companies would also be valuable. For us, attitude, intelligence, communication and values can be more important than having many years of IT sales experience. Languages Bahasa Indonesia: fluent/native English: strong working proficiency Why Join BridgeCore? This is an opportunity to join at the beginning. You will not simply inherit a finished sales process and execute it. You will have the opportunity to help shape how BridgeCore develops in Indonesia. If the company grows as we expect, we want the person joining us today to have the opportunity to grow with the company and take increasing responsibility for business development in the future . We are looking for someone who, one day, will be able to say: “I was there when we built BridgeCore.” About us BridgeCore is a new technology company being built between Indonesia and Poland. The goal is to connect Indonesian companies looking for reliable technology solutions with experienced IT specialists and technical expertise in Europe. Services include software development, dedicated IT specialists and teams, automation, AI solutions, integrations, web applications and technical consulting. BridgeCore believes in long-term relationships, transparency, responsibility and delivering solutions that genuinely solve clients' problems.

jobs.title: ACCOUNT PAYABLE SENIOR STAFF
jobs.description: 📢 WE ARE HIRING – ACCOUNT PAYABLE STAFF 📢 Apakah Anda seorang profesional Finance yang teliti, cepat, dan terbiasa mengelola pembayaran sekaligus melakukan kontrol budget? Kami membuka kesempatan bagi Anda untuk bergabung sebagai Account Payable Staff dengan tanggung jawab tidak hanya pada proses hutang usaha, tetapi juga monitoring dan kontrol harga pakan . Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal S1 Akuntansi/Keuangan atau jurusan terkait. Pengalaman minimal 2 tahun sebagai Account Payable Staff. Berpengalaman di perusahaan manufaktur, khususnya industri food/poultry menjadi nilai tambah. Memahami proses Account Payable, verifikasi invoice, dan pembayaran vendor. Memahami proses pengecekan dan kontrol harga pakan/vendor. Mampu melakukan perbandingan harga, mengecek kesesuaian harga dengan invoice dan dokumen pembelian. Terbiasa bekerja cepat, teliti, dan mampu bekerja dengan deadline. Menguasai Microsoft Excel dan administrasi keuangan. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan koordinasi yang baik. Tanggung Jawab Memproses dan memverifikasi invoice vendor. Menyiapkan dan memonitor pembayaran vendor. Melakukan rekonsiliasi hutang usaha. Memastikan kelengkapan dan kesesuaian dokumen pembayaran. Melakukan monitoring dan kontrol harga pakan dari vendor. Mengecek kesesuaian harga pakan antara invoice, PO, dan dokumen pendukung lainnya. Melakukan perbandingan harga dan membantu mengidentifikasi perubahan harga pakan yang tidak sesuai. Berkoordinasi dengan Purchasing dan pihak terkait mengenai perbedaan harga atau invoice. Menyusun laporan Account Payable dan monitoring harga secara berkala. Jika Anda teliti dalam angka, memahami proses Account Payable, dan mampu melakukan kontrol harga pakan, kami menunggu CV terbaik Anda untuk bergabung bersama tim kami!

jobs.description: About Company At Ennovi we harness the power of two megatrends - electrification and AI - to help industries innovate at speed, operate smarter, and achieve sustainable growth. By combining these transformative forces with our global reach and best talent, we empower our customers to lead their markets and drive sustainable progress. From automotive to aerospace, consumer electronics, data storage, industrial, and medical markets, we help our customers achieve these megatrends by creating smarter, safer, and more sustainable solutions. We excel in developing high-performance, custom solutions that meet diverse technical needs, solve unique challenges, optimize performance, and adapt to evolving market demands. Our mission is to get customers to the future faster, from anywhere. Headquartered in Singapore, ENNOVI has a global presence across North America, Europe, SEA and China, where all its activities are socially responsible, with minimal environmental impact. Learn more at www.ennovi.com . Why Join Us At Ennovi, we envision a future of electrification and innovation and strive to create an inspiring workplace where our employees are integral to shaping that future. We offer a dynamic, collaborative and inclusive culture that encourages continuous learning, professional growth, and a sense of purpose. As a part of the Ennovi team, employees experience the excitement of being at the forefront of cutting-edge technologies and contributing to a sustainable future. Our commitment to the transformation is epitomized by our five pillars: Speed, Innovation, Best Talent, Global Reach, and Sustainability. This entails navigating exponential market changes through agile structures, fostering innovation across all aspects of our business, strategically expanding our global footprint, championing sustainability initiatives and nurturing a winning team. Privacy Policy Ennovi is an equal opportunity employer in conformance with all applicable laws and regulations to individuals who are qualified to perform job requirements. The Company administers its personnel policies, programs, and practices in a non-discriminatory manner in all aspects of the employment relationship, including recruitment, hiring, work assignment, promotion, transfer, termination, wage and salary administration, and selection for training. By applying to this job posting, you agree with and acknowledge our privacy policy . Responsibilities of Automation Engineers Supporting production equipment during all shifts to ensure uninterrupted operations. ​Troubleshooting and resolving machine breakdowns in a timely manner. ​Performing preventive and corrective maintenance activities.Supporting robot systems, vision systems, PLCs, sensors, and automation controls.Managing machine parameter setup, backup, and restoration. ​Supporting new product introduction (NPI), process optimization, and continuous improvement activities.Coordinating with Production, Quality, Engineering, and suppliers for issue resolution. ​Monitoring equipment performance and driving OEE improvements.Supporting spare parts management and automation system reliability initiatives. Ensuring production equipment complies with safety and operational requirements Coordinate new equipment installation, equipment modification and qualification. Support equipment /process qualification including protocol development and execution. Consult with vendors to produce equipment, materials and/or parts that meet determined product specification. Develop and implement SOPs to ensure that all engineering activities are performed safely and effectively. Coordinate & management work including good project management, budgeting, resource allocation, accurate project scope definition and project scheduling to meet time & client requirement. Establish, manage and schedule preventive maintenance activities to enable smooth production operation. To establish or review safety work procedures in order to ensure all works performed are compliance with occupational health and safety (OHS) guideline. Provide technical leadership and actively collaborate across different teams and department for solving complex issue, driving improvement, etc. Implement, manage and accountable for compliance with GMP, regulatory requirements and other business system (i.e., Health, Safety, Environment and Quality) Preparing and managing budget and financial records. Plan, organize and control inventory management tools, spare parts and consumable goods. Lead Kaizen activities in the manufacturing. Serve as a technical resource for the plant locations and other departments. Assist facilities with troubleshooting particular problems in the manufacturing environments. Ensure that all personnel performing production and inspection in the production are properly trained, have the relevant skill and experience, and aware of EHS hazards and addressing actions. To assist in development of safety and health rules and safe systems of work; To review the effectiveness of safety and health programmes; To promote and develop a high level of Health, Safety, and Environmental awareness and commitment to all personnel. To provide technical / advisory support for Health, Safety, and Environmental program. To participate in reviews and audits and report findings To analyze accident trends, near-miss accident, dangerous occurrence, occupational poisoning or occupational disease at the work place. To report to the employer of any unsafe or unhealthy condition or practices at the place of work together with recommendations for corrective actions; To review the Health, Safety, and Environmental policies at the place of work and make recommendations to the employer for any revision of such policies To review with Management Representative in conducting any competition, talks and activities to promote a safe conduct of work. To inspect the place of work at least once (1) in 3 months To assists all the Management Representative in inspecting the workplace as soon as it is safe to do so, after any accident, near miss occurrence, dangerous occurrences, which has occurred. Ensure that the implementation of the ISO 13485 requirements are effectively carried out. To promote and develop a high level of Health, Safety & Environmental awareness and commitment. Adhere to safety and health rules and safe systems of work Job Requirements & Qualification Minimum Degree holder in Electrical/ Mechanical / Material / Industrial or related degree. Minimum 3 years working experience as an Equipment/Maintenance/Manufacturing/Process Engineer. Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills. Relevant experience in medical industry Knowledge in ISO 13485 standard. Exposure to working in a highly regulated medical environment. Multi-tasking for both equipment and process engineering activity. Good communication skills in English and Bahasa Malaysia. Good team player and able to work independently.

About Company

At Ennovi we harness the power of two megatrends - electrification and AI - to help industries innovate at speed, operate smarter, and achieve sustainable growth. By combining these transformative forces with our global reach and best talent, we empower our customers to lead their markets and drive sustainable progress.

From automotive to aerospace, consumer electronics, data storage, industrial, and medical markets, we help our customers achieve these megatrends by creating smarter, safer, and more sustainable solutions.

We excel in developing high-performance, custom solutions that meet diverse technical needs, solve unique challenges, optimize performance, and adapt to evolving market demands.

Our mission is to get customers to the future faster, from anywhere. Headquartered in Singapore, ENNOVI has a global presence across North America, Europe, SEA and China, where all its activities are socially responsible, with minimal environmental impact. Learn more at www.ennovi.com.


Why Join Us

At Ennovi, we envision a future of electrification and innovation and strive to create an inspiring workplace where our employees are integral to shaping that future. We offer a dynamic, collaborative and inclusive culture that encourages continuous learning, professional growth, and a sense of purpose. As a part of the Ennovi team, employees experience the excitement of being at the forefront of cutting-edge technologies and contributing to a sustainable future.

Our commitment to the transformation is epitomized by our five pillars: Speed, Innovation, Best Talent, Global Reach, and Sustainability. This entails navigating exponential market changes through agile structures, fostering innovation across all aspects of our business, strategically expanding our global footprint, championing sustainability initiatives and nurturing a winning team.


Privacy Policy

Ennovi is an equal opportunity employer in conformance with all applicable laws and regulations to individuals who are qualified to perform job requirements. The Company administers its personnel policies, programs, and practices in a non-discriminatory manner in all aspects of the employment relationship, including recruitment, hiring, work assignment, promotion, transfer, termination, wage and salary administration, and selection for training.


By applying to this job posting, you agree with and acknowledge our privacy policy.


Responsibilities of Automation Engineers

  • Supporting production equipment during all shifts to ensure uninterrupted operations.

  • ​Troubleshooting and resolving machine breakdowns in a timely manner.

  • ​Performing preventive and corrective maintenance activities.Supporting robot systems, vision systems, PLCs, sensors, and automation controls.Managing machine parameter setup, backup, and restoration.

  • ​Supporting new product introduction (NPI), process optimization, and continuous improvement activities.Coordinating with Production, Quality, Engineering, and suppliers for issue resolution.

  • ​Monitoring equipment performance and driving OEE improvements.Supporting spare parts management and automation system reliability initiatives.

  • Ensuring production equipment complies with safety and operational requirements

  • Coordinate new equipment installation, equipment modification and qualification.

  • Support equipment /process qualification including protocol development and execution.

  • Consult with vendors to produce equipment, materials and/or parts that meet determined product specification.

  • Develop and implement SOPs to ensure that all engineering activities are performed safely and effectively.

  • Coordinate & management work including good project management, budgeting, resource allocation, accurate project scope definition and project scheduling to meet time & client requirement.

  • Establish, manage and schedule preventive maintenance activities to enable smooth production operation.

  •  To establish or review safety work procedures in order to ensure all works performed are compliance with occupational health and safety (OHS) guideline.

  • Provide technical leadership and actively collaborate across different teams and department for solving complex issue, driving improvement, etc.

  • Implement, manage and accountable for compliance with GMP, regulatory requirements and other business system (i.e., Health, Safety, Environment and Quality)

  • Preparing and managing budget and financial records.

  • Plan, organize and control inventory management tools, spare parts and consumable goods.

  • Lead Kaizen activities in the manufacturing.

  • Serve as a technical resource for the plant locations and other departments. Assist facilities with troubleshooting particular problems in the manufacturing environments.

  • Ensure that all personnel performing production and inspection in the production are properly trained, have the relevant skill and experience, and aware of EHS hazards and addressing actions. 

  • To assist in development of safety and health rules and safe systems of work;

  • To review the effectiveness of safety and health programmes;

  • To promote and develop a high level of Health, Safety, and Environmental awareness and commitment to all personnel.

  • To provide technical / advisory support for Health, Safety, and Environmental program.

  • To participate in reviews and audits and report findings

  • To analyze accident trends, near-miss accident, dangerous occurrence, occupational poisoning or occupational disease at the work place.

  • To report to the employer of any unsafe or unhealthy condition or practices at the place of work together with recommendations for corrective actions;

  • To review the Health, Safety, and Environmental policies at the place of work and make recommendations to the employer for any revision of such policies

  • To review with Management Representative in conducting any competition, talks and activities to promote a safe conduct of work.

  • To inspect the place of work at least once (1) in 3 months

  • To assists all the Management Representative in inspecting the workplace as soon as it is safe to do so, after any accident, near miss occurrence, dangerous occurrences, which has occurred.

  • Ensure that the implementation of the ISO 13485 requirements are effectively carried out.

  • To promote and develop a high level of Health, Safety & Environmental awareness and commitment.

  • Adhere to safety and health rules and safe systems of work


Job Requirements & Qualification

  • Minimum Degree holder in Electrical/ Mechanical / Material / Industrial or related degree.

  • Minimum 3 years working experience as an Equipment/Maintenance/Manufacturing/Process Engineer.

  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.

  • Relevant experience in medical industry

  • Knowledge in ISO 13485 standard.

  • Exposure to working in a highly regulated medical environment.

  • Multi-tasking for both equipment and process engineering activity.

  • Good communication skills in English and Bahasa Malaysia.

  • Good team player and able to work independently.

jobs.title: Assistant Supervisor Maintenance Machine
jobs.description: PT Techno Indonesia (www.techno.co.id) adalah sebuah perusahaan yang bergerak dalam bidang mold maker dan plastic injection yang telah beroperasi sejak 1994 dan sudah bersertifikat ISO 9001 : 2015 ; 14001 : 2015 ; 45001 : 2018. Produk utama kami adalah spare part untuk kebutuhan otomotif dan elektronik. Kualifikasi : Minimal 5 - 7 tahun pengalaman di bidang pemeliharaan mesin Injection Plastic. Minimal 2-3 tahun pengalaman dalam posisi supervisor. Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 jurusan Teknik Mesin, Teknik Elektro, Teknologi Listrik, Teknik Listrik Industri atau bidang terkait. Memiliki Sertifikasi K3 Listrik (Wajib) Memiliki pemahaman mendalam tentang sistem mesin injection (sistem mekanik, pneumetik, dan hidrolik bertekanan tinggi), peralatan produksi, dan teknik pemeliharaan preventif dan korektif. Kemampuan membaca gambar teknis dan blueprint mesin. Pengetahuan tentang standar keselamatan kerja (K3) dan regulasi industri manufaktur. Memahami & menguasai Pembacaan PLC & Sistem Troubleshooting kontrol elektronik mesin. Melakukan manajemen perawatan meliputi Preventive Maintenance, Corrective Maintenance & Breakdown maintenance. Pengalaman dengan sistem perencanaan pemeliharaan terkomputerisasi (CMMS) akan dihargai. Keterampilan kepemimpinan yang kuat dengan kemampuan untuk memotivasi dan mengembangkan anggota tim. Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, baik lisan maupun tertulis dalam bahasa Indonesia. Kemampuan problem-solving yang baik dan berpikir analitis untuk mengatasi masalah teknis. Tugas & Tanggung Jawab : Mengawasi dan mengarahkan tim teknisi pemeliharaan mesin dalam melaksanakan tugas pemeliharaan rutin dan perbaikan darurat. Merencanakan jadwal & membuat laporan pemeliharaan preventif untuk memaksimalkan waktu operasional mesin & pengelolaan suku cadang. Melakukan inspeksi mesin secara berkala untuk mengidentifikasi potensi masalah dan memastikan keandalan peralatan. Mendokumentasikan semua aktivitas pemeliharaan, perbaikan, dan penggantian suku cadang dengan akurat dan tepat waktu. Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap standar keselamatan kerja dan prosedur operasional yang telah ditetapkan. Berkoordinasi dengan departemen produksi untuk meminimalkan downtime mesin dan memastikan kelancaran proses produksi. Melatih dan mengembangkan keterampilan anggota tim teknisi dalam teknik pemeliharaan dan penggunaan peralatan. Mengelola inventaris suku cadang dan memastikan ketersediaan material yang diperlukan untuk operasi pemeliharaan. Melaporkan kemajuan pemeliharaan mesin kepada atasan dan manajemen secara berkala. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Minimal 4-6 tahun pengalaman di bidang pemeliharaan mesin industri atau manufaktur. Minimal 2-3 tahun pengalaman dalam posisi supervisori atau koordinasi tim. Pendidikan minimal SMK (Sekolah Menengah Kejuruan) dengan fokus pada Teknik Mesin, Teknik Elektro, atau bidang terkait. Pemahaman mendalam tentang sistem mesin industri, peralatan produksi, dan teknik pemeliharaan preventif dan korektif. Kemampuan membaca gambar teknis dan blueprint mesin. Keterampilan kepemimpinan yang kuat dengan kemampuan untuk memotivasi dan mengembangkan anggota tim. Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, baik lisan maupun tertulis dalam bahasa Indonesia. Pengetahuan tentang standar keselamatan kerja (K3) dan regulasi industri manufaktur. Kemampuan problem-solving yang baik dan berpikir analitis untuk mengatasi masalah teknis. PT Techno Indonesia (www.techno.co.id) adalah sebuah perusahaan yang bergerak dalam bidang mold maker dan plastic injection yang telah beroperasi sejak 1994 dan sudah bersertifikat ISO 9001 : 2015 ; 14001 : 2015 ; 45001 : 2018. Produk utama kami adalah spare part untuk kebutuhan otomotif dan elektronik.

Kualifikasi :

  • Minimal 5 - 7 tahun pengalaman di bidang pemeliharaan mesin Injection Plastic.

  • Minimal 2-3 tahun pengalaman dalam posisi supervisor.

  • Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 jurusan Teknik Mesin, Teknik Elektro, Teknologi Listrik, Teknik Listrik Industri atau bidang terkait.

  • Memiliki Sertifikasi K3 Listrik (Wajib)

  • Kemampuan membaca gambar teknis dan blueprint mesin.

  • Pengetahuan tentang standar keselamatan kerja (K3) dan regulasi industri manufaktur.

  • Memahami & menguasai Pembacaan PLC & Sistem Troubleshooting kontrol elektronik mesin.

  • Melakukan manajemen perawatan meliputi Preventive Maintenance, Corrective Maintenance & Breakdown maintenance.

  • Pengalaman dengan sistem perencanaan pemeliharaan terkomputerisasi (CMMS) akan dihargai.

  • Keterampilan kepemimpinan yang kuat dengan kemampuan untuk memotivasi dan mengembangkan anggota tim.

  • Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, baik lisan maupun tertulis dalam bahasa Indonesia.

  • Kemampuan problem-solving yang baik dan berpikir analitis untuk mengatasi masalah teknis.

  • Mengawasi dan mengarahkan tim teknisi pemeliharaan mesin dalam melaksanakan tugas pemeliharaan rutin dan perbaikan darurat.

  • Melakukan inspeksi mesin secara berkala untuk mengidentifikasi potensi masalah dan memastikan keandalan peralatan.

  • Mendokumentasikan semua aktivitas pemeliharaan, perbaikan, dan penggantian suku cadang dengan akurat dan tepat waktu.

  • Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap standar keselamatan kerja dan prosedur operasional yang telah ditetapkan.

  • Berkoordinasi dengan departemen produksi untuk meminimalkan downtime mesin dan memastikan kelancaran proses produksi.

  • Melatih dan mengembangkan keterampilan anggota tim teknisi dalam teknik pemeliharaan dan penggunaan peralatan.

  • Mengelola inventaris suku cadang dan memastikan ketersediaan material yang diperlukan untuk operasi pemeliharaan.

  • Melaporkan kemajuan pemeliharaan mesin kepada atasan dan manajemen secara berkala.

jobs.description: PT. DUTA SARANA PERKASA PT Duta Sarana Perkasa is an established company operating in the precast concrete and construction materials industry. We are committed to delivering quality products and reliable solutions to our customers while continuously improving our operational and business performance. About the role As General Manager , you will be responsible for overseeing the company's overall performance, ensuring effective coordination across functions, and translating business strategies into measurable results. You will lead and coordinate key areas including Operations, Sales & Business Development, Finance, Supply Chain, and Human Resources, while ensuring that the organization operates efficiently, professionally, and in line with the company's objectives. This position is suitable for a senior leader who combines strategic thinking, commercial awareness, operational discipline, and strong people leadership. Key responsibilities : Lead the overall day-to-day business and operational activities of the company. Develop and execute business strategies, annual plans, and performance targets together with the Board of Directors. Monitor overall business performance, including revenue, profitability, operational efficiency, cost, and productivity. Coordinate and align the performance of Sales, Operations, Production, Procurement, Finance, HR. Drive sales growth and strengthen relationships with key customers and business partners. Ensure production and operational activities meet quality, cost, efficiency, and delivery targets. Monitor budgets, operating expenses, working capital, inventory, and overall financial performance. Identify opportunities for cost optimization, process improvement, and productivity enhancement. Develop and strengthen the management team and foster a culture of accountability and high performance. Establish and monitor KPIs across key functions and ensure appropriate follow-up on performance gaps. Qualification : Bachelor's degree (S1) in Business Management, Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field. Minimum 10 years of professional experience, with at least 5 years in a managerial or senior management position. Experience in manufacturing, precast concrete, construction materials, building materials, or a related industry is highly preferred. Strong understanding of business operations, sales, production, supply chain, finance, and people management. Proven experience in managing business performance, budgets, costs, and profitability. Strong leadership and decision-making capabilities. Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Able to work effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. Proficient in Microsoft Office and comfortable working with business data and performance reports. Benefits Strategic leadership role with broad business exposure. Opportunity to work closely with the Board of Directors. Opportunity to lead and develop a multidisciplinary management team. Competitive compensation package based on experience and qualifications. Opportunity to contribute directly to the company's growth and operational improvement.

PT Duta Sarana Perkasa is an established company operating in the precast concrete and construction materials industry. We are committed to delivering quality products and reliable solutions to our customers while continuously improving our operational and business performance.


About the role

As General Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing the company's overall performance, ensuring effective coordination across functions, and translating business strategies into measurable results. You will lead and coordinate key areas including Operations, Sales & Business Development, Finance, Supply Chain, and Human Resources, while ensuring that the organization operates efficiently, professionally, and in line with the company's objectives. This position is suitable for a senior leader who combines strategic thinking, commercial awareness, operational discipline, and strong people leadership.

Key responsibilities :

  • Lead the overall day-to-day business and operational activities of the company.

  • Develop and execute business strategies, annual plans, and performance targets together with the Board of Directors.

  • Monitor overall business performance, including revenue, profitability, operational efficiency, cost, and productivity.

  • Coordinate and align the performance of Sales, Operations, Production, Procurement, Finance, HR.

  • Drive sales growth and strengthen relationships with key customers and business partners.

  • Ensure production and operational activities meet quality, cost, efficiency, and delivery targets.

  • Monitor budgets, operating expenses, working capital, inventory, and overall financial performance.

  • Identify opportunities for cost optimization, process improvement, and productivity enhancement.

  • Develop and strengthen the management team and foster a culture of accountability and high performance.

  • Establish and monitor KPIs across key functions and ensure appropriate follow-up on performance gaps.

Qualification :

  • Bachelor's degree (S1) in Business Management, Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field.

  • Minimum 10 years of professional experience, with at least 5 years in a managerial or senior management position.

  • Experience in manufacturing, precast concrete, construction materials, building materials, or a related industry is highly preferred.

  • Strong understanding of business operations, sales, production, supply chain, finance, and people management.

  • Proven experience in managing business performance, budgets, costs, and profitability.

  • Strong leadership and decision-making capabilities.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Able to work effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and comfortable working with business data and performance reports.

Benefits

  • Strategic leadership role with broad business exposure.

  • Opportunity to work closely with the Board of Directors.

  • Opportunity to lead and develop a multidisciplinary management team.

  • Competitive compensation package based on experience and qualifications.

  • Opportunity to contribute directly to the company's growth and operational improvement.

Duta Sarana Perkasa, or better known as Dusaspun, is a leading precast concrete manufacturer in Indonesia offering a wide array of infrastructure, structural, architectural, and environmental products. Dusaspun and M-System are proud affiliates of a circle of Indonesia’s most renowned building materials manufacturers as DUSASPUN GROUP, including Bonna Indonesia, Lisa Concrete, Roto Rooter Indonesia, RAPI Hijau Perkasa, Djabesmen, Wavin, and Granito.", "Dusaspun was established over 30 years ago, harboring ambitions to become a prominent player in the domestic Indonesian concrete pipe market. Committed to maintaining cleanliness, hygiene, and safety standards.

jobs.title: Post Fixture Officer
jobs.description: Departemen/Divisi: Business / Post Fixture Lokasi Kerja: Jakarta Atasan Langsung: Post Fixture Coordinator Key responsibilities Memantau pergerakan dan aktivitas kapal selama pelayaran untuk memastikan kesesuaian dengan jadwal yang telah disepakati. Menyampaikan update informasi terkait aktivitas pelayaran kapal kepada klien. Memperbarui database penyewa (charterer) dan pemilik kapal (shipowner). Melakukan perhitungan laytime. Mendampingi klien dan memberikan solusi atas permasalahan yang terjadi dalam proses post-fixture. Memproses penagihan pembayaran sewa, termasuk perhitungan bunker, potongan off-hire time, dan potongan lainnya. Menyusun laporan aktivitas post-fixture secara berkala. Menyiapkan dokumen pendukung untuk penagihan komisi broker. Memastikan pembayaran dari klien diterima tepat waktu. Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal D3, seluruh jurusan. Fresh graduate dipersilakan melamar. Bersedia bekerja dengan tenggat administratif yang ketat dan mengikuti jadwal operasional kapal. Mampu mengoperasikan MS Office, khususnya Excel. Menguasai Bahasa Inggris aktif (lisan & tulisan). Memahami dasar-dasar keuangan perusahaan. What We're Looking For Achievement Orientation - berorientasi pada hasil dan pencapaian target Collaboration - mampu bekerja sama dalam tim Analytical Thinking - mampu berpikir logis dan sistematis Customer Service Orientation - berorientasi pada pelayanan yang baik Networking - mampu membangun relasi kerja dengan berbagai pihak Planning & Organizing - mampu mengelola waktu dan pekerjaan secara terstruktur Quality Excellence - teliti dan menjaga kualitas hasil kerja Proses seleksi akan berlangsung hingga 14 (empat belas) hari kerja setelah lowongan ini ditutup. Kandidat yang memenuhi kualifikasi akan dihubungi oleh tim kami dalam periode tersebut. Apabila dalam waktu 14 hari kerja setelah lowongan ditutup Anda belum menerima kabar, mohon dimaklumi bahwa Anda belum dapat kami lanjutkan ke tahap berikutnya untuk posisi ini. Seluruh data pelamar akan kami simpan dalam database perusahaan, dan dapat kami hubungi kembali apabila di kemudian hari terdapat posisi lain yang sesuai dengan profil dan potensi Anda. Departemen/Divisi: Business / Post Fixture

Lokasi Kerja: Jakarta

Atasan Langsung: Post Fixture Coordinator


Key responsibilities

  • Memantau pergerakan dan aktivitas kapal selama pelayaran untuk memastikan kesesuaian dengan jadwal yang telah disepakati.

  • Menyampaikan update informasi terkait aktivitas pelayaran kapal kepada klien.

  • Memperbarui database penyewa (charterer) dan pemilik kapal (shipowner).

  • Melakukan perhitungan laytime.

  • Mendampingi klien dan memberikan solusi atas permasalahan yang terjadi dalam proses post-fixture.

  • Memproses penagihan pembayaran sewa, termasuk perhitungan bunker, potongan off-hire time, dan potongan lainnya.

  • Menyusun laporan aktivitas post-fixture secara berkala.

  • Menyiapkan dokumen pendukung untuk penagihan komisi broker.

  • Memastikan pembayaran dari klien diterima tepat waktu.


Kualifikasi

  • Pendidikan minimal D3, seluruh jurusan.

  • Fresh graduate dipersilakan melamar.

  • Bersedia bekerja dengan tenggat administratif yang ketat dan mengikuti jadwal operasional kapal.

  • Mampu mengoperasikan MS Office, khususnya Excel.

  • Menguasai Bahasa Inggris aktif (lisan & tulisan).

  • Memahami dasar-dasar keuangan perusahaan.


What We're Looking For

  • Achievement Orientation - berorientasi pada hasil dan pencapaian target

  • Collaboration - mampu bekerja sama dalam tim

  • Analytical Thinking - mampu berpikir logis dan sistematis

  • Customer Service Orientation - berorientasi pada pelayanan yang baik

  • Networking - mampu membangun relasi kerja dengan berbagai pihak

  • Planning & Organizing - mampu mengelola waktu dan pekerjaan secara terstruktur

  • Quality Excellence - teliti dan menjaga kualitas hasil kerja


Proses seleksi akan berlangsung hingga 14 (empat belas) hari kerja setelah lowongan ini ditutup. Kandidat yang memenuhi kualifikasi akan dihubungi oleh tim kami dalam periode tersebut. Apabila dalam waktu 14 hari kerja setelah lowongan ditutup Anda belum menerima kabar, mohon dimaklumi bahwa Anda belum dapat kami lanjutkan ke tahap berikutnya untuk posisi ini.

jobs.title: DRILLING MANAGER
jobs.description: About the role The Drilling Manager will lead and oversee all offshore drilling and completions operations for the project, ensuring wells are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with technical design and regulatory requirements. This role acts as the senior technical and operational authority for drilling activities, managing rig contractors, drilling service providers, and the multidisciplinary drilling team, while serving as the primary interface between offshore operations and the onshore project management team. This role requires deep technical expertise in offshore well construction, strong leadership under high-risk operational conditions, and the ability to manage complex interfaces between drilling, subsurface, and facilities teams, particularly where wells feed into new or modified surface processing systems. Key responsibilities Drilling Operations Leadership Provide senior oversight and accountability for all offshore drilling, completion, and well intervention operations Develop and implement the offshore well construction program in alignment with the overall project schedule and development plan Oversee rig operations, ensuring adherence to well design, drilling programs, and approved procedures Manage rig scheduling, well sequencing, and mobilization/demobilization logistics across the drilling campaign Serve as the escalation point for critical operational decisions, well control events, and technical drilling issues Ensure seamless handover between drilling and completions phases, and from completions to production/facilities teams Rig & Contractor Management Manage offshore drilling rig contracts (day rate, turnkey, or integrated services models), ensuring contractual compliance and performance Oversee performance of drilling service providers: mud engineering, cementing, wireline, directional drilling, well testing, and subsea services Conduct rig audits and technical assessments to ensure equipment readiness and crew competency Lead contract negotiations, rig selection processes, and vendor performance reviews Manage rig move logistics, marine operations coordination, and logistics support (supply vessels, helicopters) Cost & Schedule Management Develop and manage the drilling AFE (Authorization for Expenditure) budget for the offshore campaign Monitor well costs against AFE, tracking variances and driving cost control initiatives Track drilling performance metrics (days per well, NPT %, cost per foot) against benchmarks and type curves Report drilling progress, cost performance, and forecast updates to the Senior Project Manager and JV partners Identify and mitigate schedule risks, including rig availability, weather windows, and equipment lead times HSE & Well Control Champion a strong HSE and well control culture across all rig operations, targeting zero incidents Ensure full compliance with well control certification requirements (IWCF/IADC) for all drilling personnel Lead or oversee well control risk assessments, BOP testing programs, and emergency response drills Ensure compliance with offshore safety regulations Lead investigations into drilling incidents, near-misses, and non-productive time events; implement corrective actions Oversee environmental compliance related to drilling discharges, spill prevention, and waste management Ensure Simultaneous Operations (SIMOPS) protocols are followed when drilling occurs alongside platform construction, production, or other rig activities Team Leadership Lead and mentor a team of drilling engineers, wellsite supervisors (company men/OIMs where applicable), and drilling support staff Oversee competency assurance and training programs for drilling personnel Foster a strong safety culture and collaborative working relationship between offshore crews and onshore support teams Conduct performance reviews and support career development of drilling team members Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in petroleum engineering or related technical field Relevant well control certifications (IWCF or IADC) 15+ years of offshore drilling experience, with progressive responsibility Minimum 5+ years in a Drilling Superintendent, Senior Drilling Engineer, or Drilling Manager role Proven track record managing offshore drilling campaigns Demonstrated experience managing multi-well drilling campaigns and rig contractor relationships Deep technical knowledge of well design, casing/cementing, drilling fluids, and completions engineering Strong understanding of well control principles, kick detection, and blowout prevention systems Proficiency About the role

The Drilling Manager will lead and oversee all offshore drilling and completions operations for the project, ensuring wells are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with technical design and regulatory requirements. This role acts as the senior technical and operational authority for drilling activities, managing rig contractors, drilling service providers, and the multidisciplinary drilling team, while serving as the primary interface between offshore operations and the onshore project management team.

This role requires deep technical expertise in offshore well construction, strong leadership under high-risk operational conditions, and the ability to manage complex interfaces between drilling, subsurface, and facilities teams, particularly where wells feed into new or modified surface processing systems.

Key responsibilities

Drilling Operations Leadership

  • Provide senior oversight and accountability for all offshore drilling, completion, and well intervention operations

  • Develop and implement the offshore well construction program in alignment with the overall project schedule and development plan

  • Oversee rig operations, ensuring adherence to well design, drilling programs, and approved procedures

  • Manage rig scheduling, well sequencing, and mobilization/demobilization logistics across the drilling campaign

  • Serve as the escalation point for critical operational decisions, well control events, and technical drilling issues

  • Ensure seamless handover between drilling and completions phases, and from completions to production/facilities teams

Rig & Contractor Management

  • Manage offshore drilling rig contracts (day rate, turnkey, or integrated services models), ensuring contractual compliance and performance

  • Oversee performance of drilling service providers: mud engineering, cementing, wireline, directional drilling, well testing, and subsea services

  • Conduct rig audits and technical assessments to ensure equipment readiness and crew competency

  • Lead contract negotiations, rig selection processes, and vendor performance reviews

  • Manage rig move logistics, marine operations coordination, and logistics support (supply vessels, helicopters)

Cost & Schedule Management

  • Develop and manage the drilling AFE (Authorization for Expenditure) budget for the offshore campaign

  • Monitor well costs against AFE, tracking variances and driving cost control initiatives

  • Track drilling performance metrics (days per well, NPT %, cost per foot) against benchmarks and type curves

  • Report drilling progress, cost performance, and forecast updates to the Senior Project Manager and JV partners

  • Identify and mitigate schedule risks, including rig availability, weather windows, and equipment lead times

HSE & Well Control

  • Champion a strong HSE and well control culture across all rig operations, targeting zero incidents

  • Ensure full compliance with well control certification requirements (IWCF/IADC) for all drilling personnel

  • Lead or oversee well control risk assessments, BOP testing programs, and emergency response drills

  • Ensure compliance with offshore safety regulations

  • Lead investigations into drilling incidents, near-misses, and non-productive time events; implement corrective actions

  • Oversee environmental compliance related to drilling discharges, spill prevention, and waste management

  • Ensure Simultaneous Operations (SIMOPS) protocols are followed when drilling occurs alongside platform construction, production, or other rig activities

Team Leadership

  • Lead and mentor a team of drilling engineers, wellsite supervisors (company men/OIMs where applicable), and drilling support staff

  • Oversee competency assurance and training programs for drilling personnel

  • Foster a strong safety culture and collaborative working relationship between offshore crews and onshore support teams

  • Conduct performance reviews and support career development of drilling team members

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in petroleum engineering or related technical field

  • Relevant well control certifications (IWCF or IADC)

  • 15+ years of offshore drilling experience, with progressive responsibility

  • Minimum 5+ years in a Drilling Superintendent, Senior Drilling Engineer, or Drilling Manager role

  • Proven track record managing offshore drilling campaigns

  • Demonstrated experience managing multi-well drilling campaigns and rig contractor relationships

  • Deep technical knowledge of well design, casing/cementing, drilling fluids, and completions engineering

  • Strong understanding of well control principles, kick detection, and blowout prevention systems

  • Proficiency with drilling engineering software

  • Strong crisis management and decision-making skills under high-pressure, time-sensitive conditions

jobs.title: Credit Marketing Officer (CMO) - JAKARTA TIMUR
jobs.description: Deskripsi Pekerjaan: Mengidentifikasi calon pelanggan potensial untuk produk pembiayaan kendaraan mobil. Membangun dan memelihara hubungan yang kuat dengan mitra bisnis, seperti showroom mobil, dealer mobil, untuk menghasilkan prospek yang berkualitas. Mengevaluasi dan memproses aplikasi kredit pelanggan secara efisien, memastikan kepatuhan terhadap kebijakan dan prosedur perusahaan. Memberikan layanan pelanggan yang unggul, menjawab pertanyaan dan membantu pelanggan selama proses pembiayaan. Mencapai dan melampaui target penjualan yang ditetapkan melalui strategi pemasaran yang kreatif dan inovatif. Mempertahankan dan meningkatkan kinerja portofolio kredit dengan memantau pembayaran dan mengelola penagihan. Berkontribusi pada pengembangan produk dan inisiatif strategis perusahaan. Kualifikasi: Minimal lulusan D3 atau S1 dari jurusan yang relevan. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang pemasaran atau penjualan kredit kendaraan mobil. Memiliki kendaraan sendiri Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi secara efektif dengan pelanggan dan mitra bisnis. Memiliki kemampuan analitis yang kuat untuk mengevaluasi aplikasi kredit. Berdedikasi, berorientasi pada target, dan memiliki etos kerja yang baik. Memahami dan dapat menerapkan regulasi serta kebijakan perusahaan yang relevan.

jobs.title: Assistant Sales Manager Mandarin Speaker
jobs.description: About the role Asisten Mandarin – Facebook, CRM & J&T role involves helping communication between Mandarin-speaking management and the Facebook, CRM, and J&T teams.
